title: Terms of Service
intro: These terms apply between {operator} and you, or the workspace you use AkunMu for. By creating a workspace or an account you accept them, together with the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 1. The service
paragraphs: AkunMu maps where accounts are signed in: on which devices, in which browser profiles and apps, and from which other sign-in each one grew. It works in the browser, with an optional browser extension and desktop app. AkunMu is not a password manager: it never asks for or keeps passwords, codes, tokens or recovery keys.

sections.heading: 2. Workspaces and accounts
items: A workspace belongs to the person or organization that created it; its admins decide who joins and with which role.
Keep your sign-in details to yourself and tell us at {contact} if you think someone else used your account.
You must be an adult, or act with the consent of your parent or guardian.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable use
items: Only map accounts and devices you are entitled to manage, and only record other people's accounts with a lawful basis, such as the device and account policy of your organization.
Do not put passwords, codes, keys or other secrets in names or notes; AkunMu refuses values that look like them.
Do not use AkunMu to monitor people secretly, to break into accounts, or to break the law.
Do not overload, probe or work around the security of the service.

sections.heading: 4. Processing on the workspace's behalf
paragraphs: For the sign-in map, the workspace is the controller and {operator} is its processor (UU PDP Art. 51). This section is the agreement between them as required by PP 33/2026:
items: {operator} processes the map only to provide AkunMu as the workspace instructs, and not for its own purposes.
People at {operator} who can reach the data are bound to confidentiality, and access is limited to support and security.
{operator} uses the subprocessors listed in the Privacy Policy and tells workspaces about changes in that policy.

{operator} helps the workspace answer data subject requests (the workspace's Privacy menu and Settings → My data), keep its records of processing activities and DPIAs, and handle personal data breaches, which it reports to the workspace without delay.
When the workspace deletes data or itself, the data is deleted for good; the workspace can download its records before that.
{operator} keeps the security measures described in the Privacy Policy and can show how it meets this agreement.

sections.heading: 5. AI features
paragraphs: The assistant can answer questions about the map and propose changes; every change waits for your confirmation. AI answers can be wrong: check them before relying on them. A workspace may use AkunMu's AI within its plan's quota, or its own provider key.

sections.heading: 6. Extension and desktop app
paragraphs: The extension and the desktop app report only what the Privacy Policy describes, with a key the workspace creates and can revoke. Install them only on browsers and computers you are entitled to manage.

sections.heading: 7. Availability and changes
paragraphs: We work to keep AkunMu available and secure, but cannot promise that it is never interrupted. We may improve or change features; when a change matters to you, we tell you in the app before it takes effect.

sections.heading: 8. Plans and fees
paragraphs: New workspaces start on a trial. Paid plans, their prices and quotas are shown before you choose them; nothing is charged without your agreement.

sections.heading: 9. Ending
paragraphs: You can erase your account, or as an admin the whole workspace, at any time in Settings → My data. We may suspend a workspace that breaks these terms or puts others at risk, after telling its admins where possible.

sections.heading: 10. Liability
paragraphs: AkunMu helps you see where accounts are signed in; signing them out and securing them stays with you and the services those accounts belong to. To the extent the law allows, {operator} is not liable for indirect losses. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer and personal data protection law.

sections.heading: 11. Law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Disputes are settled amicably first; otherwise by the competent court in Indonesia. Questions: {contact}.
